From The Lock · Price: the target must have harmed you or an ally.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: a creature that damaged you or an ally this fight feels guilt (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will}): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} on a failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} on a critical failure.
  • 5: Surge: the lock grows: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2} for 1 round.
  • 9: The lock also makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} on a critical failure.
  • 13: It can't take reactions while locked.
  • 17: At the end of each of its turns while locked, the creature attempts a new @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save; on a failure its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled} value rises by 1 (maximum 4). Helping the creature it hurt ends the lock.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.531NKfAJOMkplmFZ]{Effect: Guilt Lock}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
